rules.title: The individual arguments provided by a TestCaseAttribute must match the type of the corresponding parameter of the method
rules.description: The individual arguments provided by a TestCaseAttribute must match the type of the corresponding parameter of the method.

rules.description: The number of arguments provided by a TestCaseAttribute must match the number of parameters of the method.

rules.title: The type of the value specified via ExpectedResult must match the return type of the method
rules.description: The type of the value specified via ExpectedResult must match the return type of the method. Otherwise, this will lead to an error at run-time.

rules.title: ExpectedResult must not be specified when the method returns void
rules.description: ExpectedResult must not be specified when the method returns void. This will lead to an error at run-time.

rules.title: The method has non-void return type, but no result is expected in ExpectedResult
rules.description: The method has non-void return type, but no result is expected in ExpectedResult.

rules.title: Specifying ParallelScope.Self on assembly level has no effect
rules.description: Specifying ParallelScope.Self on assembly level has no effect.

rules.title: One may not specify ParallelScope.Children on a non-parameterized test method
rules.description: One may not specify ParallelScope.Children on a non-parameterized test method.

rules.title: One may not specify ParallelScope.Fixtures on a test method
rules.description: One may not specify ParallelScope.Fixtures on a test method.

rules.title: The TestCaseSource argument does not specify an existing member
rules.description: The TestCaseSource argument does not specify an existing member. This will lead to an error at run-time.

rules.title: The async test method must have a non-void return type
rules.description: The async test method must have a non-void return type.

rules.title: The async test method must have a non-generic Task return type when no result is expected
rules.description: The async test method must have a non-generic Task return type when no result is expected.

rules.title: The async test method must have a Task<T> return type when a result is expected
rules.description: The async test method must have a Task<T> return type when a result is expected.

rules.title: The source type does not implement I(Async)Enumerable
rules.description: The source type must implement I(Async)Enumerable in order to provide test cases.

rules.title: The source type does not have a default constructor
rules.description: The source type must have a default constructor in order to provide test cases.

rules.title: The specified source is not static
rules.description: The specified source must be static.

rules.title: The number of parameters provided by the TestCaseSource does not match the number of parameters in the target method
rules.description: The number of parameters provided by the TestCaseSource must match the number of parameters in the target method.

rules.title: The source specified by the TestCaseSource does not return an I(Async)Enumerable or a type that implements I(Async)Enumerable
rules.description: The source specified by the TestCaseSource must return an I(Async)Enumerable or a type that implements I(Async)Enumerable.

rules.title: The TestCaseSource provides parameters to a source - field or property - that expects no parameters
rules.description: The TestCaseSource must not provide any parameters when the source is a field or a property.

rules.description: The ValueSource should use nameof operator to specify target.

rules.title: The specified source is not static

rules.description: The target method expects parameters which cannot be supplied by the ValueSource.

rules.description: The source specified by the ValueSource must return an I(Async)Enumerable or a type that implements I(Async)Enumerable.

rules.title: The ValueSource argument does not specify an existing member
rules.description: The ValueSource argument does not specify an existing member. This will lead to an error at run-time.

rules.title: The test or setup/teardown method is not public
rules.description: The test or setup/teardown method is not public.

rules.title: The test method has parameters, but no arguments are supplied by attributes
rules.description: The test method has parameters, but no arguments are supplied by attributes.

rules.title: The non-test method is public
rules.description: A fixture should not contain any public non-test methods.

rules.title: The number of parameters provided by the TestCaseSource does not match the number of parameters in the Test method
rules.description: The number of parameters provided by the TestCaseSource must match the number of parameters in the Test method.

rules.title: The type of parameter provided by the TestCaseSource does not match the type of the parameter in the Test method
rules.description: The type of parameters provided by the TestCaseSource must match the type of parameters in the Test method.

rules.title: The individual arguments provided by a ValuesAttribute must match the type of the corresponding parameter of the method
rules.description: The individual arguments provided by a ValuesAttribute must match the type of the corresponding parameter of the method.

rules.title: An IDisposable field/property should be Disposed in a TearDown method
rules.description: An IDisposable field/property should be Disposed in a TearDown method.

rules.title: The Write methods on TestContext will be marked as Obsolete and eventually removed
rules.description: Direct Write calls should be replaced with Out.Write.

rules.title: Base TestFixtures should be abstract
rules.description: Base TestFixtures should be abstract to prevent base class tests executing separately.

rules.title: The 'step' parameter to Range cannot be zero
rules.description: The 'step' parameter to Range cannot be zero.

rules.title: The value for 'from' must be less than 'to' when 'step' is positive
rules.description: Ensure that 'to' is greater than 'from' when 'step' is positive.

rules.title: The value for 'from' must be greater than 'to' when 'step' is negative
rules.description: Ensure that 'from' is greater than 'to' when 'step' is negative.

rules.title: The type of the attribute values doesn't match the parameter type
rules.description: Ensure that the attribute and parameter types match.

rules.description: Consider using the constraint model, Assert.That(expr, Is.False), instead of the classic model, ClassicAssert.IsFalse(expr).

rules.title: The actual value should not be a constant
rules.description: The actual value should not be a constant. This indicates that the actual value and the expected value have switched places.

rules.title: Incorrect IgnoreCase usage
rules.description: The IgnoreCase modifier should only be used for string or char arguments. Using it on another type will not have any effect.

rules.title: The same value has been provided as both the actual and the expected argument
rules.description: The same value has been provided as both the actual and the expected argument. This indicates a coding error.

rules.description: Using EqualConstraint will lead to better assertion messages in case of failure.

rules.title: Consider using Assert.That(expr, Is.Not.Null) instead of ClassicAssert.IsNotNull(expr)
rules.description: Consider using the constraint model, Assert.That(expr, Is.Not.Null), instead of the classic model, ClassicAssert.IsNotNull(expr).

rules.title: Incompatible types for SameAs constraint
rules.description: The SameAs constraint always fails because the actual and expected values have mutually exclusive types.

rules.title: Incompatible types for EqualTo constraint
rules.description: The EqualTo constraint always fails as the actual and the expected value cannot be equal.

rules.title: Missing property required for constraint
rules.description: The actual argument should have the required property for the constraint.

rules.title: Invalid NullConstraint usage
rules.description: NullConstraint is allowed only for reference types or nullable value types.

rules.title: Wrong actual type used with String Constraint
rules.description: The type of the actual argument is not a string and hence cannot be used with a String Constraint.

rules.title: Wrong actual type used with ContainsConstraint
rules.description: The ContainsConstraint requires the type of the actual value to be either a string or a collection of strings.

rules.title: Wrong actual type used with the SomeItemsConstraint with EqualConstraint
rules.description: The SomeItemsConstraint with EqualConstraint requires the actual argument to be a collection where the element type can match the type of the expected argument.

rules.title: Consider using Assert.That(actual, Is.GreaterThan(expected)) instead of ClassicAssert.Greater(actual, expected)
rules.description: Consider using the constraint model, Assert.That(actual, Is.GreaterThan(expected)), instead of the classic model, ClassicAssert.Greater(actual, expected).

rules.title: Non-reference types for SameAs constraint
rules.description: The SameAs constraint always fails on value types as the actual and the expected value cannot be the same reference.

rules.title: Incompatible types for comparison constraint
rules.description: The comparison constraint always fails as the actual and the expected value are not comparable.

rules.title: Comparison constraint on object
rules.description: The comparison constraint might fail as the actual and the expected value might not implement IComparable.

rules.title: Use ComparisonConstraint for better assertion messages in case of failure
rules.description: Using ComparisonConstraint will lead to better assertion messages in case of failure.

rules.title: Non-delegate actual parameter
rules.description: The actual argument needs to be evaluated by the Assert to catch any exceptions.

rules.title: Use Assert.EnterMultipleScope or Assert.Multiple
rules.description: Hosting Asserts inside an Assert.EnterMultipleScope or Assert.Multiple allows detecting more than one failure.

rules.title: Use CollectionConstraint for better assertion messages in case of failure
rules.description: Use Has.Length/Has.Count/Is.Empty instead of testing property directly.

rules.title: Incompatible types for Within constraint
rules.description: The Within modifier should only be used for numeric or Date/Time arguments or tuples containing only these element types. Using it on other types will not have any effect.

rules.title: Consider using Assert.That(...) instead of StringAssert(...)
rules.description: Consider using the constraint model, Assert.That(actual, {0}(expected)), instead of the classic model, StringAssert.{1}(expected, actual).

rules.title: Consider using Assert.That(...) instead of CollectionAssert(...)
rules.description: Consider using the constraint model, Assert.That(actual, {0}(expected)), instead of the classic model, CollectionAssert.{1}(expected, actual).

rules.title: NUnit 4 no longer supports string.Format specification
rules.description: Replace format specification with interpolated string.

rules.description: Consider using the constraint model, Assert.That(expr, Is.Positive), instead of the classic model, ClassicAssert.Positive(expr).

rules.title: Consider using Is.InstanceOf<T> constraint instead of an 'is T' expression
rules.description: Consider using Is.InstanceOf<T> instead of 'is T' expression for better assertion messages.

rules.title: Consider using Assert.EnterMultipleScope statement instead of Assert.Multiple/Assert.MultipleAsync
rules.description: Consider using Assert.EnterMultipleScope statement instead of Assert.Multiple/Assert.MultipleAsync.

rules.title: Remove unnecessary lambda expression
rules.description: Only the argument value is needed by the Assert.

rules.title: The constraint is misused
rules.description: The constraint didn't take the operator precedence into account.

rules.title: Task result of method should be used
rules.description: Methods that return a Task should have their results observed to ensure proper handling of completion and errors.

rules.title: Simplify the Values attribute
rules.description: Consider removing unnecessary parameters from the ValuesAttribute.

rules.title: Use Specific constraint
rules.description: Replace 'EqualTo' with a keyword in the corresponding specific constraint.
